answer.summary: The Spring ApplicationContext fails to load for every API test class, so all listed tests error before running. The cause is a bean dependency cycle: workflowService -> workflowEndService -> notificationEventService -> scenarioNotificationEventHandler -> exerciseService -> workflowService. WorkflowEndService and NotificationEventService are both touched by this change, and the cycle will repeat on every re-run, so retrying will not help. Fix the constructor dependency cycle.

Caused by: org.springframework.beans.factory.BeanCurrentlyInCreationException: Error creating bean with name 'workflowService': Requested bean is currently in creation: Is there an unresolvable circular reference or an asynchronous initialization dependency?
Relying upon circular references is discouraged and they are prohibited by default. Update your application to remove the dependency cycle between beans.
